note: EVIDENCE-REQUIREMENT PROFILE (Phase 69) — the determination-licensing evidence a case must carry before the workbench will license a DETERMINATION rather than a defensive filing. CHOSEN, not measured: the atoms + sufficiency thresholds are authored from public AML guidance + the capability taxonomy, NOT learned from past dispositions (the substrate is label-blind — see the §12/§14 honesty seam). Illustrative — the always-on 'Illustrative data & outputs' badge applies. required_elements mirror aml_casework.contract.STR_REQUIRED_ELEMENTS at the vendored pin (vendor/aml-casework/VENDORED_AT); evidence/data codes are capability (C*) / data-source (D*) codes from data/capability-taxonomy.json. Companion-only: NOT a ship or build input (build.py never reads it).

money_laundering.label: Money laundering

atoms.label: Placement / layering mechanism
atoms.rationale: funds moved in a laundering shape — cash placement (C5 cash-intensity anomaly), rapid pass-through (C2), or multi-originator funnel-in / fan-out (C3) — not a single threshold touch

atoms.label: Evasion intent, not amount
atoms.rationale: structuring WITH design evidence (cancel-on-trigger, same-day multi-location) — the FinCEN-2025 principle that an amount near a reporting threshold is not, by itself, suspicion; the intent to evade is

atoms.label: Profile inconsistency
atoms.rationale: activity off the customer's expected peer (C7) or income / occupation (C8) profile — the 'no legitimate economic purpose' leg

atoms.label: Network / beneficial-ownership linkage
atoms.rationale: shell / nominee / beneficial-ownership link or a counterparty-network edge — who really controls the funds (network analysis)

atoms.label: External corroboration
atoms.rationale: a sanctions / watchlist or adverse-media hit on the subject or a network affiliate, gathered and record-sourced

atoms.label: Anticipated-activity inconsistency
atoms.rationale: actual activity inconsistent with the ONBOARDING anticipated profile (expected volume / value / nature of business); activity consistent with the anticipated profile would instead MITIGATE

atoms.label: Source of funds not established
atoms.rationale: source of funds / source of wealth not established or inconsistent with the activity; an established legitimate source would MITIGATE

money_laundering.guidance: the named predicate risk grounds back to the corpus specific-risk guidance — the typology of the case's cited signals (data/indicator-typology-map.json / data/typology-map.json). A program becomes effective by naming the specific risk it files for (e.g. human trafficking, fentanyl), not the generic offence.

kyc_integrity.label: KYC integrity

atoms.label: Customer-cooperation / KYC-integrity failure
atoms.rationale: refusal to provide CDD, evasive answers, or document inconsistency — the C14 integrity signal itself

atoms.label: Beneficial-ownership opacity
atoms.rationale: the beneficial owner is not disclosed or not resolvable — the inability to identify who controls the entity IS the suspicion (absence is evidence)

kyc_integrity.guidance: kyc_integrity files on the integrity failure itself; subject_information must be present — you must know WHO you cannot verify. The named risk grounds to the C14/C15 guidance the cited signals derive from.
